item.title: Ant Group Releases LingSante-3.1-flash: An Open-Weight MoE Model with 560B Total Parameters and 25B Activations per Token
item.description:
Ant Group's Afu team open-sourced LingSante-3.1-flash, a 560B-parameter MoE medical AI model with 25B active parameters, a 1M-token context and an MIT license. It ranks first among open models on InclusionMed.

item.title: Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache
item.description:
Tencent open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoding drafter for sparse-attention LLMs. Each draft layer reuses the target's KV cache and top-k indexer picks, adding no draft KV memory and lifting 64K serving throughput by up to 81%.

The post Tencent Open-Sources DFly2: Speculative Decoding That Reuses the Target’s Sparse KV Cache appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small, a 30B Model Built on Nemotron 3 Nano
item.description:
Sakana AI released Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B-A3B reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano. It averages 60.1 across 25 benchmarks, ahead of the 120B Nemotron 3 Super at 56.2.

The post Sakana AI Releases Namazu Small, a 30B Model Built on Nemotron 3 Nano appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
item.description:
Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

The post ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet Facebook’s Your Algorithm: How Meta Turns Plain-Language Preferences Into Ranking
item.description:
Meta's engineering team explains how Facebook's Your Algorithm turns plain-language interests into ranking signals for Feed and Reels, using LLM validation, 4 retrieval sources, layered filtering and a fine-tuned LLM reranker.

The post Meet Facebook’s Your Algorithm: How Meta Turns Plain-Language Preferences Into Ranking appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime
item.description:
OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release, BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux. AI agents write signed "shields" that block exploit paths on running systems while teams test and roll out real patches.

item.description:
Anthropic's Claude Ship bundles Code Review, PR Steward and Claude Approvals to review, fix and approve GitHub pull requests. Code Review is GA; the other 2 agents are in public beta for Team and Enterprise.

item.description:
Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first Loop Transformer flagship. The 750B-scale model runs 28 GLM-5 layers twice for deeper reasoning, with API access and open weights planned after safety work.
